blocks.text: TURIN, Italy— With seven Grand Slam quarterfinals to his name and belief that he can still go further, Alex de Minaur reached a point earlier this year where his ambitions got in the way of his performance. Now the player nicknamed “The Demon” is searching within to make sure it doesn’t happen again. In town as the first alternate at the ATP Finals — the elite event for the year’s top eight players that he narrowly missed out on qualifying for this season — he’s had time to reflect on why, as he said, he “kind of went walkabout” during a […]...
